default-hover.$description: state — hover partner of text-default. Lightens in dark, where light darkens

subtlest.$description: contract — 5.15:1 on bg-default. The floor: gray-forest/500 is 3.14:1 and has no foreground name

disabled.$description: state — 3.14:1 on bg-default. Deliberately dimmer than light mode's disabled, which sits at 4.97:1 and reads as live text; this is the one place dark does not mirror light's step. text-subtlest stays the legible floor

brand.$description: contract — 7.66:1 on bg-default. brand/600 would be 1.63:1 here — the deep green needs a light step, not a dark one

brand-hover.$description: state — hover partner of text-brand. 10.13:1 on bg-default

error.$description: contract — 5.97:1 on bg-default. Red travels further down the ramp than the other tones for the same brightness

on-accent-subtle.$description: contract — 9.15:1 on bg-accent-subtle. Accent finally has room here — in light it fails on bg-default at 3.06:1

on-inverse.$description: contract — 14.41:1 on bg-inverse. Inverse flips with the mode: the light surface is the inverted one here

on-inverse-subtle.$description: contract — 6.57:1 on bg-inverse. Tooltip description text

default.$description: ground — the page, cards, fields. Raised one step off gray-forest/950 so a recessed surface has somewhere to go

hover.$description: state — hover on bg-default. Dark lifts where light recedes

selected.$description: state — chosen from a list. Pairs with text-on-brand-subtle

inverse.$description: ground — the surface that inverts against the mode — light here. Pairs with text-on-inverse

overlay.$description: contract — the scrim. Denser than light mode's 60% because a dark page has less room to lose. Separation in dark comes from elevation, not from the scrim: gray-forest/900 over a 950 scrim is 1.18:1. Settle with the modal (ADR-0022)

neutral-subtle.$description: ground — recessed surfaces, tracks, the neutral tone. A layer RISES in dark: 800/700/600 is the ladder light runs as 50/100/300

neutral-strong.$description: ground — inert control channels: slider track, scrollbar thumb

brand-subtle.$description: ground — 1.14:1 on bg-default — pairs with text-on-brand-subtle

brand-solid.$description: fill — text-* is ILLEGIBLE here; use text-on-brand-solid. Steps up from 600: the deep green reads as a hole on a dark page

brand-solid-hover.$description: state — darkens, as in light — brand/400 would drop white to 4.37:1

error-subtle.$description: ground — 1.15:1 on bg-default — pairs with text-on-error-subtle

warning-subtle.$description: ground — 1.15:1 on bg-default — pairs with text-on-warning-subtle

success-subtle.$description: ground — 1.15:1 on bg-default — pairs with text-on-success-subtle

accent-subtle.$description: ground — 1.15:1 on bg-default — pairs with text-on-accent-subtle

error-solid.$description: fill — white is 4.83:1, unchanged from light — the red already carries on a dark page

default.$description: contract — the load-bearing border — 2.19:1 on bg-default

inset.$description: decorative — the avatar hairline. It LIGHTENS in dark — an 8%-black edge is invisible on gray-forest/900

brand.$description: contract — interactive affordance — 5.06:1 on bg-default, unchanged from light: a 300 step is light enough to read on either ground

error.$description: contract — conveys invalidity (InputField error ring) — 8.57:1 on bg-default

warning-solid.$description: contract — 7.09:1 on bg-default. Same reason as success-solid: standalone in Badge, and warning/700 is 3.07:1 — on the threshold, not clear of it

success-solid.$description: contract — 6.03:1 on bg-default. Brightens away from its fill: Badge uses this STANDALONE as the pill-outline border, where success/700 is 2.92:1 and fails the 3:1 non-text threshold. Nothing pairs it with bg-success-solid. Figma binds #17b26a
